articles.title_en: Ozon was the big winner from Wildberries’ ruin. Five weeks later, it’s the target of Ukraine’s drone attacks.
articles.lead_en: For a third straight night, Ukraine’s military has struck warehouses belonging to the Russian online marketplace Ozon. The first drone strike, overnight on August 22, targeted the company’s warehouse in Chapaevsk (Samara region); the building caught fire and several people were injured.
